Detailed Path-Hygiene Report

Source: R/repro_indicators.R
path_hygiene_report.Rd

Produces a line-by-line report of the absolute or non-portable file paths in a submission's scripts, as a companion to the assess_path_hygiene() indicator (R-REPRO-002). Where that indicator returns a single pass/fail evidence row with a count, this function returns a tidy table naming every offending path: the file and line it appears on, the category of non-portability, the path text itself, and an advisory suggested relative-path rewrite.

Usage

path_hygiene_report(path)

Arguments

path

Path to the submission's analysis code folder.

Value

A tibble with one row per offending path and the columns file (path relative to path, with forward slashes), line (line number, integer), type (the category of non-portability), path (the offending path text), and suggestion (an advisory relative-path rewrite, or NA when none could be derived). A submission with clean paths returns a zero-row tibble with these columns.

Details

This is a descriptive helper, not an indicator. It emits no R4SUB evidence, carries no severity, and does not change the pass/fail or score of assess_path_hygiene() in any way. The suggested rewrites are advisory starting points for making a path portable, not guaranteed replacements.

Each row's type is one of "windows_drive" (a drive-letter path such as C:/...), "unc_share" (a \\server\share UNC path), "home_dir" (a ~ home-directory reference), or "posix_absolute" (an absolute POSIX path such as /home/...). Only quoted string literals are inspected, and strings that look like URLs are ignored.

See also

assess_path_hygiene() for the pass/fail indicator.

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "sub_hygiene")
dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(c(
  "adsl <- read.csv('C:/Users/me/study/data/adsl.csv')",
  "adae <- read.csv('/home/me/study/adae.csv')",
  "home <- readRDS('~/cache/model.rds')",
  "ok   <- read.csv('data/adlb.csv')"
), file.path(d, "analysis.R"))
path_hygiene_report(d)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 5
#>   file        line type           path                            suggestion   
#>   <chr>      <int> <chr>          <chr>                           <chr>        
#> 1 analysis.R     1 windows_drive  C:/Users/me/study/data/adsl.csv data/adsl.csv
#> 2 analysis.R     2 posix_absolute /home/me/study/adae.csv         adae.csv     
#> 3 analysis.R     3 home_dir       ~/cache/model.rds               model.rds
